title: Agreement of the scan and canonical grammar checks
statement: Let $F$ be a machine format, and let $\alpha$, $b$, and $r$ be finite bit strings. Suppose the aligned pair parser applied to $\alpha$ returns $(b,r)$, the string $b$ is the canonical least-significant-bit-first binary representation of its value $n$, and $\max\{g,(4k+5)3^{k+1}\}(n+1)\le |r|$, where $g$ is the format's guard and $k$ is its number of work tapes. Then scanning $\alpha$ returns the same result as the following check on $r$: consume a unary index smaller than $n+1$, skip the transition table for $n+1$ states and $k$ work tapes, and accept exactly when every bit in the remaining suffix is $1$, returning that suffix.
